task_title: verify the printed npm>=12 remedy against a real npm 12
task_criteria: The remedy printed by scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh and documented in README.md is executed end-to-end on npm 12.2.2 (not --dry-run) in a scratch install: npm install-scripts approve --no-allow-scripts-pin better-sqlite3 re-enables the build script and the native binding loads, or the printed command is corrected to the one that does; a committed probe transcript proves it

items.criterion: The remedy printed by scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh and documented in README.md is executed end-to-end on npm 12.2.2 (not --dry-run) in a scratch install: npm install-scripts approve --no-allow-scripts-pin better-sqlite3 re-enables the build script and the native binding loads, or the printed command is corrected to the one that does; a committed probe transcript proves it
items.detail: Independently reproduced the whole probe with the real npm 12.2.2 CLI (/home/kara/.local/share/vite-plus/package_manager/npm/12.2.2/npm/bin/npm-cli.js, `--version` -> 12.2.2, node v22.22.3) in a fresh scratch dir /tmp/npm12-probe-review containing only better-sqlite3 ^12.11.1: (1) `npm install` -> exit 0 with 'npm warn install-scripts 1 package had install scripts blocked because they are not covered by allowScripts: better-sqlite3@12.11.1 (install: prebuild-install || node-gyp rebuild --release)'; `node check-binding.js` -> 'Error: Could not locate the bindings file', exit 1, no build/ dir. (2) `npm install-scripts approve --no-allow-scripts-pin better-sqlite3` -> 'Approved better-sqlite3:\n  added better-sqlite3', exit 0, package.json gains "allowScripts":{"better-sqlite3":true} (unpinned); binding still missing right after approve, exactly as docs/npm12-allowscripts-probe.md §2 states. (3) `npm rebuild better-sqlite3` -> 'rebuilt dependencies successfully' exit 0; `node check-binding.js` -> 'sqlite_version() -> 3.53.2' exit 0; `npm install-scripts ls` -> 'No packages with unreviewed install scripts.' No --dry-run anywhere. The committed transcript docs/npm12-allowscripts-probe.md matches this run line-for-line, and its counter-probes also reproduce: 5a (rebuild without approval -> 'npm warn rebuild 1 package had install scripts blocked...' + 'rebuilt dependencies successfully', exit 0, binding still missing, node exit 1), 5b (`install-scripts deny` then `approve` -> 'better-sqlite3 is denied; remove the entry from allowScripts to approve better-sqlite3.' / 'Nothing to approve; allowScripts unchanged.', exit 0), 5c (approve without the flag -> 'added better-sqlite3@12.11.1', package.json "allowScripts":{"better-sqlite3@12.11.1":true}). Repo gate `npm run check:sqlite-binding` -> 'OK: better-sqlite3 native binding loads (SELECT 1 -> {"x":1})' exit 0. Remedy text was correctly left unchanged; README.md:74-78 and scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh:78-96 carry the same three commands. Test run: `npx vitest run tests/npm12-remedy-doc.test.ts` -> 'Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 5 passed (5)'. [resolution 0.03; scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh, README.md]

items.criterion: The committed probe transcript docs/npm12-allowscripts-probe.md is truthful — its claimed commands and outputs reproduce on the real npm 12.2.2 in this environment (not fabricated)
items.detail: Every claim in docs/npm12-allowscripts-probe.md was re-executed and matched: install warning text, 'Approved better-sqlite3:\n  added better-sqlite3', the unpinned allowScripts diff, 'rebuilt dependencies successfully', 'sqlite_version() -> 3.53.2', 'No packages with unreviewed install scripts.', plus counter-probes 5a/5b/5c (see criterion 1 detail). The only deviation is the documented one: the transcript uses a one-line check-binding.js instead of inline `node -e`, which the doc explains at the top and which performs the same require + in-memory query.

items.criterion: The remedy printed by scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh (npm>=12 branch) and the README remedy are the same command sequence as the verified one (approve --no-allow-scripts-pin -> rebuild -> check:sqlite-binding), with no drift between printed text and verified text
items.detail: scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh:78-96 prints step 1 `npm install-scripts approve --no-allow-scripts-pin better-sqlite3`, step 2 `npm rebuild better-sqlite3`, step 3 `npm run check:sqlite-binding`; README.md:74-78 prints the identical three commands in the identical order. That is exactly the sequence I executed successfully on npm 12.2.2. The commit diff confirms the remedy steps themselves were not altered (only a trailing Note block was added at scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh:88-92).

items.criterion: The remedy text is reachable from the real entrypoint: the npm>=12 branch of check_sqlite_binding actually prints it when the binding fails, and `npm run check:sqlite-binding` (package.json:32) invokes that script
items.detail: Reachability proven by simulation: /tmp/redsim2 with a stub node_modules/better-sqlite3 that throws 'Could not locate the bindings file' and a stub npm reporting 12.2.2 — `bash scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh --sqlite-binding-only` printed 'FAIL: better-sqlite3 is installed but its native binding does not load.' then 'Remedy (npm 12.2.2): 1. ... npm install-scripts approve --no-allow-scripts-pin better-sqlite3 ... 2. npm rebuild better-sqlite3 ... 3. npm run check:sqlite-binding' plus the new Note lines, and exited 1. package.json:32 maps "check:sqlite-binding" to `bash scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh --sqlite-binding-only`, and running it in the repo prints 'OK: better-sqlite3 native binding loads (SELECT 1 -> {"x":1})' exit 0.

items.criterion: The new parity test tests/npm12-remedy-doc.test.ts passes and would fail if the script/README/probe command strings drifted apart
items.detail: `npx vitest run tests/npm12-remedy-doc.test.ts` -> 'Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 5 passed (5)'. Failure sensitivity checked by mutation: replacing the README command with the pinned form (`npm install-scripts approve better-sqlite3`) made the suite red — 'Tests 1 failed | 4 passed (5)' — then README was restored and the suite went green again (git status shows only the pre-existing _index.json modification). The test also cross-checks the printed approval JSON against README.md and the real package.json allowScripts (package.json:35-37).
